dialogues.speaker: Onegov
dialogues.text: Hey, have you heard? The conveyor belt at the harbor entrance has broken down...

dialogues.speaker: Anfisa
dialogues.text: *sigh* Let me guess, you're about to tell me this is all part of some earth-shattering conspiracy?

dialogues.speaker: Onegov
dialogues.text: Hehe, indeed, I can see your eyes are open to the truth like mine!

dialogues.speaker: Onegov
dialogues.text: Those vulgar vagrants probably think it's got something to do with how the belt hasn't been maintained in years, but smart people like you and I can see behind the curtain...

dialogues.speaker: Onegov
dialogues.text: There's no doubt about it, this is a trap set by the higher-ups. I don't yet know why they'd intentionally sabotage the conveyor belt, but they surely have their motives...

dialogues.speaker: Anfisa
dialogues.text: ...Give it a rest, will you? You said the same thing the last time Speranza updated their daily specials. "Lady Marionette has surely been planning this for a year, to ensure the people of Nasha Town are unable to eat hot dogs on this exact day"...

dialogues.speaker: Onegov
dialogues.text: You don't know what Her Majesty the Tsaritsa and her Harbingers are planning. I'm just saying, there's something bigger behind that conveyor belt breaking down, and we'd be best to steer well clear of it.
